newsitem.title: USA: Utd Meridian files for 5.75 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Utd Meridian files for 5.75 mln shr offer.

text.p: United Meridian Corp said on Friday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the sale of 5.75 million shares of common stock.
Of the total shares being offered, United Meridian said it will sell 3.25 million and certain stockholders will sell 2.5 million.
Proceeds from the sale of stock by United Meridian will be used to fund planned exploration and development activities and for general corporate purposes, the company said.

Merrill Lynch & Co will serve as lead manager of the stock offering and will be joined by co-managers J.P. Morgan & Co, Howard, Weil, Labouisse, Friedrichs Inc and Petrie Parkman & Co, United Meridian said.
